description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy of Rs. 65 per kg on Importation of Rice
categorisation: This gazette notification is an order made under Section 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory changes to import duties on rice, specifically waiving a portion of the Special Commodity Levy. This content involves the modification of existing legal/regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for importers, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory nature of the content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government classification type.
